question: Hello, is there any Indian student association or South Asian club at Ramapo? I am new graduate student and want to meet people from my culture.
answer:
Yes. The club directory lists South Asian Club (Student Organization): https://archway.ramapo.edu/SAC/ [1]. Its purpose is “to bring all the South Asians together” and share awareness of South Asian culture; email southasians@ramapo.edu. [3] South Asian Club is also listed among Ramapo’s culturally based student organizations. [11]

Other options: Culture Club (Student Organization): https://archway.ramapo.edu/CultClub/. [2] NAACH teaches South Asian dances and is open to anyone interested; email naach@ramapo.edu. Its page describes it as a dance club, but it is not listed in the club directory. [6][7] United Asian Association (UAA) focuses on Asian-Pacific Islander American cultures; email uaa@ramapo.edu. [9]

All clubs listed on the clubs page are open to students. [5] For help getting involved, contact the Center for Student Involvement at SC-202, csi@ramapo.edu, (201) 684-7593. [5]

Sources: [1](https://archway.ramapo.edu/SAC/) [2](https://archway.ramapo.edu/CultClub/) [3](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/organization/south-asians-ramapo/) [5](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/) [6](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/organization/naach/) [7](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/organization/naach/) [9](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/organization/united-asian-association-uaa/) [11](https://www.ramapo.edu/oabc/home/you-belong-at-ramapo/)

question: what cultural clubs are exist at Ramapo, can you give me the list

Of these, the directory entries provided are South Asian Club (Student Organization; https://archway.ramapo.edu/SAC/) and Naach (Student Organization - Arts, Community, Cultural, Social; https://archway.ramapo.edu/Naach/). [1][11] The other organizations named above are not among the directory entries provided. [1]

Other culturally oriented groups described on the club pages include Spanish Club, Association of Latinos Moving Ahead, Balkan Club, International Student Organization, and Hillel. [13][15][16][18][19]
